name: Sorriso, Mato Grosso, Brazil
elevationNote: Cerrado plateau, roughly 350–400 m above sea level
tagline: Large grain farms with a sharp wet and dry season
description: Sorriso is in the Cerrado of Mato Grosso, one of the world's largest soybean-producing areas. A long wet season is followed by months with almost no rain.
farmingContext: Many farms plant soybean at the start of the wet season and a second crop (often maize) straight after the soybean harvest.
The second crop must finish before the dry season, so planting dates are critical.
Cover crops are also used to protect soil during the dry months.

seasons.name: Wet season
seasons.description: Main rains, roughly October to April.

seasons.name: Dry season
seasons.description: Very little rain, roughly May to September.
